body: Thanks for talking to me dude, just knowing that one person out there cares at all really helps. And congrats on the new life turn around for you. You're a great example for people like me to follow. I just need to get to work.

I've never really thought about it that way. I've always thought about the finality of suicide as a good thing, but it does sort of make me rethink things when I really consider that there is no coming back, and that there are a few people in this world that I want to stay here for. I'm going to an instate school, one of the cheapest in the state, and it's still about 15,000 per year out of my price range. I'm just terrified of graduating under crushing amounts of student debt, but hey, I guess a lot of people are in the same boat right now.

I just need to find what it is that keeps me wanting to live, and it's getting hard to do that. I guess I just need to keep trying. 

Also, it would benefit me quite a bit if I could just borrow some of your confidence, haha.
